name: Files and Photos
trigger: Your business runs on documents, site photos, or uploads that need to be stored securely and found later.
summary: Direct-to-storage upload with signed URLs. Virus scanning before a file becomes accessible is not optional in any product where customers upload documents: an uploaded file is quarantined until it is scanned, and file.uploaded is published only after it clears.

requires.reason: Every upload has an owner and an access decision.
Scanning, thumbnailing, and processing are slow and must survive a restart. Kernel work would drop them.

enhances.unlocks: generated documents are stored and versioned rather than regenerated on every view
uploaded documents become extraction inputs automatically
field photos attach to a job from the mobile surface
file contents and metadata become searchable

privacy.retention_note: Deletion removes the stored object as well as the row; a retained row pointing at a deleted object is a broken export.

owns.name: UploadSession
owns.description: Short-lived signed-upload grant. Expired sessions are reaped.

publishes.name: file.uploaded
publishes.description: Published only after the file has been scanned and cleared, so a consumer never processes an unscanned object.

consumes.name: entity.deleted
consumes.reason: cascade-delete files attached to a deleted entity, including the stored objects

exposes.name: upload
exposes.description: Returns a signed direct-to-storage grant. File bytes never pass through the application.

external.purpose: Store uploaded objects outside the database.

credentials.name: STORAGE_BUCKET
credentials.description: Bucket or container name for this environment.

credentials.name: STORAGE_CREDENTIALS
credentials.description: Service account or access key for signing and object access.

external.purpose: Scan uploads before they become accessible.

credentials.name: SCANNER_ENDPOINT
credentials.description: Scanning service endpoint. When absent, the 'reject' scan policy must be configured explicitly.

driver.description: The 'local' driver writes to the filesystem and is for the local workspace provider only.

scan_policy.description: 'skip' is permitted only for the local provider; validation errors if a cloud environment configures it.

slots.name: allowedTypes
slots.description: Client-specific content-type rules beyond the configured list.

slots.name: sizeLimits
slots.description: Client-specific size limits, usually per entity or per role.

slots.name: processingPipeline
slots.description: Client-specific derivation work: resizing, redaction, format conversion.

smoke.name: upload, scan, and retrieve
smoke.asserts: a signed upload completes, is scanned, and is retrievable via a signed URL

smoke.name: unscanned files are inaccessible
smoke.asserts: a file awaiting scan returns 404 rather than 200 from a signed URL

smoke.name: signed URLs expire
smoke.asserts: a signed URL past its TTL is rejected by storage

contract.scenario: an entity holding attached files is deleted
contract.asserts: every attached file row AND its stored object are removed, leaving no orphaned objects
the scan job resumes and the file does not remain permanently quarantined
